causal.assumptions_right: The -23bp print was a residual, not a regime; mean-reversion to the zero anchor was the realization, and flattening there matched the stated reaction function instead of hunting a new NZ policy shock.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: Underweighted that permission would flip to research-only at the same moment the residual completed, removing any option to fade an overshoot in NZ sovereign space, and underweighted that a zero print can be both thesis-complete and the floor of the old residual.
causal.causal_divergence: The result came from residual closure, not from a dated RBNZ or U.S. coupon catalyst. The research-only constraint is a mandate change, not evidence that NZ-US 10s are fairly valued from here.
causal.future_implication: Do not reopen NZ_10Y or NZ-US_10Y. If kiwi cheapness reappears, express it in markable FX such as AUDNZD or NZDUSD, not in frozen NZ rates-RV.
causal.observed_reality: Over about 20 days the residual closed to zero and the short was flattened at that anchor; the sleeve was then frozen to research-only, so the same rates-RV ticket cannot be reopened even if the spread later overshoots.
causal.original_belief: The NZ-US 10-year residual at -23bp was NZ rich to the United States, a transitory cross-market dislocation that would mean-revert toward a zero differential rather than mark a new fair-value NZ premium.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: Knowing the residual would retrace to zero and that new NZ sovereign tickets would be research-only, the close at the zero anchor is still the correct trade; holding past zero for a NZ-cheapening overshoot would have been a new, unpermitted ticket.

items.expression_assessment: The rates-RV sleeve was the correct expression until it became research-only; remaining kiwi cheapness belongs in markable FX.

facts.invalidation: Cover the CORRA receive if Bank of Canada 2027 hikes are delivered or the strip reprices back through the 3.13 entry, especially on a sticky oil-and-goods inflation impulse. Cover the NZ-US short if the 10-year spread cheapens further from minus 23 basis points toward richer New Zealand, including on an RBNZ easing surprise or a Treasury-led selloff that leaves New Zealand yields stuck.

items.future_rule: When an RV residual completes at its stated anchor in a sleeve that is becoming research-only, flatten and migrate any remaining country view into a still-tradable FX expression rather than inventing a new rates ticket in the frozen sleeve.
items.lesson: When an RV residual completes at its stated anchor in a sleeve that is becoming research-only, flatten and migrate any remaining country view into a still-tradable FX expression rather than inventing a new rates ticket in the frozen sleeve.
items.thesis_assessment: The original thesis that the residual was transitory and would close toward zero was realized; the result came from residual closure, not a dated catalyst.
items.what_failed: The research-only mandate flip arriving at the same moment the residual completed was underweighted, so there was no option to fade a later overshoot in New Zealand sovereign space.
items.what_worked: The minus-23 basis-point residual mean-reverted to the stated zero anchor, and flattening there matched the reaction function instead of hunting a new New Zealand policy shock.

causal.assumptions_right: The cross did fall in the direction of the short, and covering once that decline had printed matched the original target.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: Further open-ended downside through 1.23 was overstated once the kiwi was already extremely weak on a one-year view.
causal.causal_divergence: The sign matched. The only gap is that the move stalled near 1.23 instead of extending.
causal.future_implication: Do not re-open an AUDNZD short from a finished 1.25 to 1.23 decline unless a new policy or terms-of-trade break appears.
causal.observed_reality: The short was closed after AUDNZD moved from 1.25 to 1.23, and the cross has since only drifted to 1.2275.
causal.original_belief: Pragmatist treated AUDNZD near 1.25 as rich versus Australia's flatter path and expected the cross to fall.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: With the same entry the short would still be put on from 1.25, and with the same exit it would still be covered rather than reloaded.

facts.invalidation: The receive is wrong if March Canada implieds reverse back through 3.13 on an oil-led Bank of Canada re-hike. The cross is wrong if AUDNZD holds above 1.2456 and extends on a Hormuz risk-off that keeps liquidating kiwi. Flatten the new FX if the 99th-percentile stretch persists without any mean-reversion over the tactical window.

items.no_new_lesson: The move from 1.25 to 1.23 was ordinary bounded variance around a short that was right on sign. The prior process remains sound: cover once the move is delivered instead of reloading a winning close.
items.thesis_assessment: The Australia-kiwi short was confirmed on sign and was covered when the move from 1.25 to 1.23 had been delivered.
